title: Rust test summary in the PR status block
summary: This change adds a Rust test summary to the pull request status block. A new `changeset_tests` module parses the base and head versions of every changed `.rs` file with tree-sitter, compares the tests it finds by module path plus function name, and renders added, changed and removed tests grouped by crate and file. The status block gains a `**Tests**` section between Approach and the end marker, and `osf pr status refresh` now always starts a block (with a placeholder when Problem/Approach are absent) instead of doing nothing. The CLI is reorganised: `osf risk` becomes `osf changeset risk`, `osf status` becomes `osf pr status`, and a new `osf changeset tests` prints the summary on its own. New git helpers (`merge_base`, `diff_name_status_between`, `path_exists_at`) support the diff, and the shared test-file pattern is widened to catch prefix-style names like `test_thing.py`.

nodes.label: osf CLI
nodes.subtitle: clap command tree
nodes.summary: The command tree is regrouped: `changeset risk`, `changeset tests`, and `pr status render|apply|refresh`. The old top-level `risk` and `status` commands are gone.

nodes.label: changeset tests
nodes.subtitle: changeset_tests_cmd
nodes.summary: Prints the Rust test summary alone, with `--base` and `--head` defaulting to `origin/main` and `HEAD`.

nodes.label: pr status render
nodes.subtitle: pr_status_render_cmd
nodes.summary: Builds the block from named inputs. A new `--base` flag makes it compute the test summary against `HEAD` and thread it into the block.

nodes.label: pr status refresh
nodes.subtitle: pr_status_refresh_run
nodes.summary: Recomputes the block from live pull request state. It now always starts a block, using `--problem`/`--approach` or the `not filled in yet` placeholder, and always builds the test summary.

nodes.label: changeset_tests
nodes.subtitle: summarize / render
nodes.summary: Parses base and head versions of each changed `.rs` file with tree-sitter, compares tests by module path plus function name, and renders the summary grouped by crate and file. Never builds or runs the code.

nodes.label: changeset_risk
nodes.subtitle: assess
nodes.summary: The blast-radius module, renamed from `risk`. Its `TEST_FILES` pattern is now `pub(crate)` and widened to match prefix-style test names such as `test_thing.py`.

nodes.label: pr_status
nodes.subtitle: render / apply
nodes.summary: The status block renderer, renamed from `status`. `RenderInput` gains an optional `tests` string, inserted between Approach and the end marker; the module stays a pure function of its inputs.

nodes.label: git
nodes.subtitle: merge_base / diff_name_status_between
nodes.summary: New plumbing: `merge_base`, `diff_name_status_between` with a `ChangedPath` enum that keeps renames whole, and `path_exists_at` to tell a missing path from an unresolved revision.
